findings.detail: Preserve refusal terminals and native retained summaries. Missing message_stop remains a transport error; no refusal retry or account rotation is added.
Retained native summaries must keep thinking signature deltas and actual stop details, and must not invent end_turn.
Both local and upstream missing Thread phrases are request-scoped, not unavailable models. Sparse history is never silently recreated.

Coalesce concurrent lookups; cache bounded TTL; reuse a previously resolved address only through a brief transient resolver failure; retain TLS verification. Authoritative negative responses invalidate the cached address before a later transient failure.
Three retained requests contained implicit 5-minute markers before explicit 1-hour markers. Native caller TTL choices remain unchanged; this does not establish a gateway corruption.
Quota, upstream overload and revoked credentials remain distinct from transport/translation defects. Banned accounts and safety refusals are not bypassed.
